notes.title: For One Year's next update will be releasing in about two weeks!
notes.notes:
Just a quick announcement to let you know that For One Year's next release, which will take the game out of early access, will be landing in about two weeks!

All the major content is done and ready. There's just a little more testing to do, and perhaps a few more season-specific graphics tossed in, and then it's release time!

Thanks for waiting! 🙏 Y'all are the best!

notes.title: It's been a month! How's development of For One Year's next update going?
notes.notes:
[h2]For One Year update status[/h2]

Writing & artwork for Sylvie - the synesthetic painter who will be For One Year's next dateable character - is looking good! The broad strokes are in place, and all the little details are getting filled in. Next will be play-testing, tweaking, and yet more testing, until everything's looking good!

This release will also include new "entertainers"! I'm sure you noticed that once you completed the main entertainer story-line the dateable traveling entertainer is replaced by a couple no-name entertainers (well, they do have names, but you get what I mean: they're side characters just so that the entertainer's wagon still has a purpose). It was always the intention for there to be [i]four[/i] of these "no-name" entertainers, to give you a little more variety in case you decide to keep visiting, but in order to not delay the initial release of the entertainers, two of the four were cut! (In fact, if you ever went digging around in the game files, you may have even noticed the other portrait graphics for the two cut entertainers!) Well, now those two have been given full-screen encounter art - I hope you look forward to "meeting" them in the next release ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/1d2373fce3dc97a8d16ecb0e559e23375ca42454.png[/img]

[h2]A lovely review of One Possible Future [/h2]

GeekGasm.org gave a lovely review of One Possible Future, here: https://geekgasm.org/2025/03/13/one-possible-future-review-retro-robot-sex-adventure/

If you haven't checked it out yet, and a shorter adventure with girls & robots (and a chill synth soundtrack) sound like something you'd be interested in, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3272320/One_Possible_Future/]please give One Possible Future a try :)[/url]

[h2]Hushberry's next game[/h2]

Alongside For One Year's next update, work on Hushberry's next [i]game[/i] is also progressing! Without saying too much, it's looking like it will be a game about racing in the late 70s to early 90s, with a funky-synth soundtrack. The gameplay is currently looking to be little closer to For One Year than One Possible Future, with mini-games and a variety of dateable characters, but the game is still in very early development and subject to change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/b9cda9e1211ee5198fb36d34fa6a461c219776f4.png[/img]

[h2]Thanks for playing![/h2]

And I hope you're looking forward to meeting Sylvie as For One Year comes out of early access!

👋 Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/cf73f2ab92d0f165342982356d43d521a4dbfcc7.png[/img]

notes.title: For One Year's next update will bring the game out of "Early Access"
notes.notes:
It's time to start wrapping up For One Year!

Since it's release last April, the game has seen many improvements and additions: new mini-games, graphics, skills, lore, and, of course, characters to date♥~ bringing the total number of hand-written dateable characters to 12! But like the bakeries of old, why not throw in just one more and make it a baker's dozen?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/a2e76e5f0e5d77d0211e9646d6e25c331549ba47.jpg[/img]

Development has begun on Sylvie, the Painter. You can expect to find her painting something from nature once per season, culminating in a fifth & final date before you finally return home.

This will likely be For One Year's last big update for a while. Bug fixes and other tweaks are always on the table, but work has ALSO begun on Hushberry Games' next major game. It's still in the very early exploration stage, so not much can be said about it yet. Pixel graphics, a CRT filter, and Intiface Central integration are almost certain. Current explorations include a modern-day setting, and more arcade-y mini-games, but even saying that much is probably saying too much - a complete 180 is still very possible!

If you'd like to keep up on the development of For One Year and this as-of-yet unnamed next game, you can follow Hushberry Games here on Steam, [url=https://twitter.com/HushberryGames]on Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://soundcloud.com/hushberry-games]on Soundcloud[/url], and now [url=https://blog.hushberrygames.com/]on Hushberry Games' new blog[/url].

Thanks for playing, thanks for reading, and as always: have fun! ;)

notes.title: September 2024 Release
notes.notes:
This was one of the largest updates of For One Year! Adding three new characters was perhaps a bit overly-ambitious, and definitely caused the release to take longer than previous releases! And it wasn't just three new characters: a lot of changes and additions went into this update - For One Year is much closer to coming out of Early Access with this release!

Thank you for your patience, and please enjoy this update ;)

Quick warning before getting to the full list of changes: [b]if you have an existing save, it may not load properly[/b], and if it does load, it's likely to be confused on which scenes you have and have not completed. (Sorry! This has been improved for future releases!)

[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Three new characters to meet: Anika (the Ghost), Effie (the Historian), and Gris (the Thief)
[*] Oinoie, Chapter 5, now includes a couple full-screen graphics (more to come in future updates!)
[*] Oinoie now has a Chapter 6
[*] Corrected Oinoie's skin color in one of the Chapter 3 background images
[*] A couple new "random hookup" scenarios are available; one was removed
[*] Various dialog tweaks across many chapters and other scenes, including weather-aware changes (for example, the Hot Springs will be closed if it's raining or snowing)
[*] Updated some of the really-old/wonky fullscreen art for the Faefolk encounter, and a couple villager encounters
[*] When speaking with Kitka, her earlobe no longer vanishes in certain poses/emotes
[*] Tweaked Robin's hair, so it no longer looks like she's mad in certain poses/emotes
[/list]

[h3]Carrying Capacity[/h3]
[list]
[*] The traveler now has a carrying capacity with this update!
[*] You can now throw treasures out (if you want to make room for more) - there's a confirmation dialog when doing this
[*] Some treasures which were not sellable are now sellable
[*] Your starting bow and fishing rod... CAN be thrown out!
[*] Some scenes may play out differently if you're full of items (for example, Kitka and Cillian won't give you a cooking pot if you can't carry one)
[/list]

[h3]Mini-games[/h3]
[list]
[*] At the start of the cooking minigame, a graphic to let you know that your goal is to make 2x2 squares of ingredients
[*] Scoring larger groups of ingredients is recognized, and grants a permanent increase to your food carrying capacity
[*] You will no longer find arrows in caves
[*] You can now find Gold and Silver Coins in caves
[*] A couple new bird types can be encountered when hunting
[*] Birds now audibly rustle in their bushes when taking off
[/list]

[h3]Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two skills have been added, allowing you to increase your carrying capacity
[*] "Crossing rivers is free" skill has been moved under the fishing skills
[*] The "Half the number of logs" skill has been removed
[*] The skill that replaces Silver Chalices with Gold Chalices in caves now ALSO replaces Silver Coins with Gold Coins
[*] There are four new "secret" skills, not seen on the skill tree unless/until you learn them
[/list]

[h3]Visuals, Sounds, and Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "title cards" at the start of a scene with a recurring character, to let you know what chapter you're on, and that "this is different from the random villagers you meet in town"
[*] Character dialog windows have received a visual update, including character-specific colors to make it easier to tell when the current speaker has changed
[*] A new song
[*] Several new sounds
[*] Several new season-aware fullscreen graphics across the game
[*] The HUD (top-left and top-right status info) has received some little changes, mainly to accommodate inventory capacity
[*] The CRT filter no longer looks awful at certain zoom levels
[*] The "parallax backgrounds" that move with your mouse are now less-jumpy when the background image changes
[/list]

[h3]Meta[/h3]
[list]
[*] There are several new achievements
[*] Backwards compatibility with old saves is improved... for future versions of the game. If you have an existing save, it may not load properly
[*] Updated many underlying libraries, including those for Intiface Central, adding support for even more bluetooth-enabled [i]toys[/i]
[*] You can now click with the right mouse button, in addition to the left, to interact with the game
[/list]

And that about does it!

Again: thanks for playing, and have fun :)

notes.title: What to expect in the next release
notes.notes:
The next release of For One Year approaches! The major content additions, and a handful of smaller changes, are nearly finished. A few more lines of dialog; a couple more pictures; a thorough round of testing or two... and then it's time!

Current estimated release date is in about two weeks, but it could get pushed to three - this has been a sizable update, and there's a lot to test!

Here's what you can expect:
* When continuing a game from a previous version of For One Year, you'll receive a warning that the game might not work 100% correctly (if possible, please finish up any current games before the next release!)
* Made some improvements to game save & load to reduce the number of issues in games played across FUTURE versions of For One Year
* Three new characters to meet: the Ghost, the Historian, and the Thief - see the previous announcement for more!
* Also detailed in the previous announcement: a maximum carrying capacity for the Traveler
* New skills to learn, including four that can only be learned in a library...
* The appearance of the character dialog window has been revamped: every character's name now has a color, to hopefully make it more clear who is speaking at any given moment
* A couple additions to hunting: a new bird, new sound effects, and a surprise...
* Cooking yields a little more food than before
* During cooking, forming larger rectangles of contiguous ingredients increases your maximum food capacity. (How and why? Shh: it's a video game.)
* At least 5 new achievements (one or two might get sneaked in during the next couple weeks)
* Added a couple new villager events
* Removed an old villager event that didn't really fit with the lore of the game anymore, and tweaked the dialog in a few other events to be more consistent with the game's story
* One new song, new sound effects, and lots of new artwork to support all of the above, including seasonal variants for some existing background images
* Some events and dialog segments have been updated to dynamically reflect the current season & weather
* Replaced two of the older/wonkier graphics in the faefolk encounter with new, higher-quality images
* Updated a few third-party code libraries to their latest versions, which should improve overall performance, and hopefully fix a rare crash-on-startup bug that players have been running into now and again!

And that should be it! Pardon if a couple updates got missed, and thanks for waiting while this latest release gets polished to release quality :)

notes.title: Next Release - Progress Report
notes.notes:
You may recall that in the last update, only one new character was released... it seemed reasonable to expect the same for this release, yet, somehow, THREE new characters are nearing completion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/fa6d3bee2778c5895e36a3a96261f4fe0978c8e1.png[/img]

Of course, the last release introduced the cooking mini-game, and that took a lot of development time! No time spent making mini-games apparently meant more time making new characters! (Seems obvious, in retrospect!)

Though this release won't feature a new mini-game, there are several tweaks to existing mechanics, the most notable being that the traveler now has a maximum amount of STUFF they can carry - food, arrows, and treasures are counted separately, each with its own maximum!

Putting limits on the traveler's carrying capacity has inspired several other changes: new skills to raise those limits, new treasures to find in caves, the ability to drop treasures to make room for new ones, and other related changes.

The release date, and full list of changes, aren't yet known, but things are certainly starting to take form!

Keep your eyes peeled for future updates, thanks for playing, and have fun ;)

notes.title: Work on the next release has begun!
notes.notes:
During development for the previous release, work had started on TWO new characters to meet: Nora the Inventor, and Anika... the Ghost! Anika didn't make it into that release, of course (though it's possible you've already found her Butterfly Charm necklace), but she'll absolutely be in this upcoming release!

A ton of progress has been made on Anika, already: the four chapters of her story had already been largely written during the previous release cycle, and are now almost complete.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/237301bbf6cb52f6b86c298762adf83e0f7b3adc.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/237301bbf6cb52f6b86c298762adf83e0f7b3adc.gif[/img][/url]

It's a bit early to say what all will be in this release - old ideas are being revisited, and new ideas generated - but the cooking mini-game could use a little attention: there's zero instruction on how to play, and when you form groups of 2x3 or 3x2 ingredients, only a 2x2 block is removed! :| Getting a 2x3 or 3x2 block should obviously yield a super-cool bonus, not do nothing!

So, yeah: expect some improvements to cooking, and one idea usually breeds others, so addressing those two known issues might [i]stir up[/i] some more new ideas!

Along the lines of mini-games, some early work was done on a lock-picking mini-game, with the idea of making cave exploration a little more interesting, but stopped because, hey: isn't the point of For One Year to meet and hook up with people; not pick locks? Expanding on the the random hookups, which currently can get a bit samey, feels like a better use of time! There are no concrete plans, yet, but it's definitely being looked into! (And even though the caves won't be getting a lock-picking mini-game, they could stand for a little more visual variety...)

And that's all that's known at the moment, but as mentioned: one idea usually breeds another! No one could have guessed there'd be rentable carriages and different cooking pot types in the last release; even Nora's weird inventions weren't dreamed up until halfway into writing her script.

Expect additional posts here as development progress, and thanks for playing! 💞

notes.title: Next major release coming soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Big stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] A new character to meet: Nora, a traveling inventor and salesperson. Try out her triple-shot bow, and heavy rod, while you're hiking the country!
[*] A new mini-game: Cooking! There are a variety of pots and pans you can collect to cook with. (Make sure to talk to Robin on your way out, to get your first pot!)
[*] CRT filter, for extra nostalgia.
[*] After winning the game, you now unlock a music player.
[*] The "new game" UI has been simplified, making it easier to choose your character's appearance.
[/list]

[b]Medium-ish stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] Fish and bird quantities now vary with the seasons, following patterns inspired by real life.
[*] At the conclusion of hunting, fishing (and cooking), the exact food that each bird, fish (and cooking ingredient provided) is now shown.
[*] There's a couple new "rare" treasures you can find in chests around the world.
[*] The game now prefers to show you episodes of stories you've already started, rather than starting brand new ones.
[*] When a town is followed by a town, you may be able to rent a stagecoach to get you speedily from one to the next.
[*] The "Treasures" window now supports paging (previously, if there were too many items for one screen, the extras got cut off by the edge of the game window!)
[*] Fixed a crash if you left town with a skill point, AND the game wanted to warn you that you were dangerously low on food.
[*] More "random hookup" villager graphics, two new stories, more town & tavern backgrounds for those stories, AND you can now choose to "look around" while visiting a town's hot springs - more graphics, there, too! ;)
[*] The final episode of Kitka's story now includes a dialog choice.
[/list]

[b]Smaller stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] Fishing ends automatically once there's nothing but logs left.
[*] Rain now has a cooling effect - no more 80° showers!
[*] It can now snow even if the temp is above 32° - just like in real life!
[*] There are a couple new types of fish to fish!
[*] When you've drained your stamina during hunting, the hunting reticle now flashes, as well.
[*] If you've looked at the game logs, you may have seen worrying-looking error messages related to intiface central (the software that lets you use bluetooth-enabled toys with the game). These weren't really errors; the message has been cleaned up, to be less worrying-looking.
[*] Some text tweaks and typo fixes across the game.
[/list]

[b]And that's it![/b]

This release will be out soon - hopefully in just a few days! Have fun ;)

notes.title: Work on the next release is underway!
notes.notes:
Work on the next release of For One Year is well underway. The two big updates in this release are the addition of Nora - a traveling inventor - and a cooking mini-game!

[h2]Nora[/h2]

Nora is a traveling inventor selling her unique creations. Unfortunately you, the traveler, are much too poor to afford Nora's wares, but she's willing to strike a deal to let you borrow them, for a time!

By meeting Nora, you'll get access to a weird bow, and even weirder fishing rod, to use in your travels.

And, of course, you'll also have the opportunity to get to know her better, as well! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/202aa8d1f21e7f4cc9b77972759b1bc4037b081b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cooking[/h2]

When you find food in the wild, you'll now have the option to either take it as-is, or cook it! If you do well at the cooking mini-game, you could end up with even more food!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/42cb1025691532528175c9085f3fb2f3d1fb2a7c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/42cb1025691532528175c9085f3fb2f3d1fb2a7c.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]CRT Filter[/h2]

As a retro-styled game, it's almost embarrassing that For One Year didn't launch with this option! (Better late than never?)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/183cfcb70da43828d185914e98f599148a87c1d9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925470/183cfcb70da43828d185914e98f599148a87c1d9.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]And more![/h2]

The character creation screens has been simplified, to reduce "typing" (typing with a mouse! blegh!), and make it easier to select your character's appearance.

There are now dialog choices scattered throughout the game's stories, giving you opportunities to learn about the people you meet (and more to do on repeated playthroughs), and just express yourself a bit from time to time.

There are already a few more full-screen images for some of the random villagers you can meet, and a few more will surely be added before release!

[h2]Release date for this update?[/h2]

It's hard to say, exactly. Nora, and the cooking mini-game, are well underway, but still incomplete. For example, work on Nora's unique bow is nearly complete, but work on her fishing rod has not yet started! There's also the possibility of a second, new character being added!

More updates to come, and as things start to wrap up, a release date will be announced!

notes.title: For One Year will release with support for many programmable toys!
notes.notes:
I discovered the incredible project https://buttplug.io/, which creates a single interface for users of toys, and developers (such as myself), to easily use any toy with any game that supports it (or that has had support added by modders).

After just a couple hours of playing with buttplug.io, it appears to be SO easy to program for, that For One Year's early-access launch will definitely include support, to some degree!

The depth and breadth of that support, I can't make specific promises to, since I'm not far enough into using the software to know what problems I may run into. Here are two possible extremes:

[b]Best-case Scenario[/b]
In the best-case scenario, For One Year will launch with a feature that allows players, at the start of a scene, to pair devices with parts of their bodies, and to have those devices activated when the character in the game receives attention to those parts of their body. For example, there is a threesome in the game, and your character receives attention on multiple parts of their body, sometimes simultaneously. I believe buttplug.io will make it easy for me to do this.

[b]Worst-case Scenario[/b]
In the worst-case scenario, the above proves more complex than expected, and For One Year launches with a simpler "uh, just select one device, and For One Year will activate that one device no matter what part of the player character's body is receiving attention".

[b]What to Expect[/b]
I expect reality will play out somewhere in between these two extremes, but where exactly is impossible to know, at this point.

I'll keep you posted! :)

[hr][/hr]

[i]For more news & updates, [url=https://www.patreon.com/HushberryGamesLLC]follow Hushberry Games on Patreon![/url][/i]

notes.title: Gearing up for First Release
notes.notes:
I'm working through a pre-release checklist - a list of all the items I need to complete to feel comfortable launching - and it's going well!

When you start a new game of For One Year, you can choose some details about your anatomy, which affects the scenes you see. One big chunk of work over the past few weeks has been going over all the scenes and confirming they're finished, whether you've got "boy" or "girl" bits. (There are other details, like the length of your hair, or color of your skin, that WON'T necessarily be 100% represented for the first release, but are already in a pretty good state, and will definitely be polished up after first release!)

The other big thing that needs to be finished up is the dance with death minigame. When you die, you can challenge death for a second shot at life (or a shot with her ;P) and that mini rhythm game is technically playable, winnable, and loseable, but also not as interesting as it could be.

The final round of work will be testing that the steam achievements all work, but unlike the other to-do items here, that will probably only take a couple hours to verify.

[hr][/hr]
Here's the checklist as it stands now, and if you'd like to see some more behind-the-scenes graphics (and get a sneak-listen to some sounds~♥), you can support Hushberry Games over at Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/HushberryGamesLLC
